q: Which financial statement shows the financial position of a business at a specific date?
exp: A balance sheet shows the financial position of a business at a specific date.

a4: Two sets of books are kept
exp: Double-entry means every transaction has a debit and a credit effect.
An asset is something of value that a business owns or controls.

a2: Decrease in asset value over time
exp: Depreciation is the decrease in value of an asset over its useful life.

q: Which of these is a liability?
exp: Loans are liabilities — money that the business owes to others.
